components.name: msUntilMidnightIST
components.description: Milliseconds until the next midnight in India.

components.description: Zero-padded hours, minutes, seconds from a duration.

components.name: byTrending
components.description: Sort comparator: most bought, then best rated, then newest.

components.accessibility: Renders no UI.

components.accessibility: Renders no UI.
components.name: reportError
components.description: Sends a browser crash/error report to /api/log (max 5 per page load, repeats skipped). Never throws.

components.accessibility: Renders no UI.
components.name: describeError
components.description: Turns any thrown value into { message, detail } for reportError.

components.accessibility: Polite text only; aria-live off so updates aren't announced.
components.name: AutoRefresh
components.description: Re-runs the page's server queries every N seconds while the tab is visible, with a 'last updated' line.
